_comment: Canonical spellings from ENTITY_LIST.md. text_fixes are unambiguous ASR misspellings and are applied everywhere (also sent to Gladia custom spelling, which matches case-insensitively). capitalized_only_fixes are real words or real names that are only rewritten when capitalized mid-sentence and not preceded by an article or title. context_hints are never auto-replaced; they are shown to LLM correction/notes passes. aliases are legitimate nicknames to keep as spoken.

context_hints.Baron: Usually the noble title (Baron/Baroness is real in the Imperial Peerage); only Berridin when someone is clearly addressing or naming Berridin.
context_hints.Din: Berridin's nickname. Keep it when spoken; it always refers to Berridin.
context_hints.high net worth: ASR has heard this as "a Nick's individual"; never turn it into Nyx.
context_hints.the area: ASR sometimes hears "the Lara"; do not turn "the Ellara" into the character unless she is being addressed.
context_hints.Static: "The Static" is campaign lore; lowercase static is just the word.
context_hints.nites (lowercase): Gladia's vocabulary boost sometimes turns the word "night" into "nites"; only Nites (capitalized, the deity) is the name.
context_hints.here: The GM pronounces Hýr like "here"; "the story of here" / "here guides us" usually means Hyr.
